budget_rules.accounting: Keep each family, period and currency separate. No automatic addition across families or inference that line items are exhaustive.

examples.operator_note: Retain this original example separately from the 230/365-day prose. Do not silently correct either source or certify a score.

coverage.state: Use the selected dated methodology; retain any divergence and actual baseline evidence.

published_calendar_example.note: Source calendar example is dated 2026. It does not replace the explicit saved assessment date or silently resolve the annex's timing algorithm.

country_documents.baseline_scope: Countries where the organisation worked and directly implemented projects within the last year, checked against an official annual report or organisation data portal; explicit allowed exclusions need evidence.

provenance_notes: Schema/codelist validation, document availability, content suitability, freshness and coverage are separate observations.
A saved operator decision is attributable to its actor and assessment date; it is not a change to PWYF's source.
Preserve budget status, original value text, currency and value-date. Do not convert currencies for an unsupported headline total.
Document fetch success or a valid URL is not a finding that its full content satisfies an indicator.
